figures.caption: Figure 1 Continuous twin-screw extruder-mixing: transition of composite powder premix to fibrillated strings (left) and to fine granules (right) as end product, controlled by screw configuration and temperature (a). Batch- mixing: transition of composite powder after high-shear mechanofusion (left) to fibrillated powder bulk (right) as end product, controlled by material sequencing, time, temperature, and rotational speed (b). Extruder mixing: SEM images of the composite microstructure with PTFE fibril network (c) and a close-up view on deformed SE particles covering the CAM surface (d) with its corresponding EDX measurement (e). Batch mixing after PTFE fibrillation: SEM image of the composite microstructure with CA agglomerate highlighted by red ellipse (f). Batch mixing after MF step (without PTFE): SEM close-up image of CAM surface (g) with its corresponding EDX measurement (h). EDX measurement are displayed by layered images combining the SEM image with O-, Ni-, Co-, Mn-Signals (green) referring to the CAM, and S-, P-, Cl-Signals (purple) referring to the SE.
